openingMessage: Failure is not fatal, but failure to change might be.
openingWhy: A near-miss is the well telling you exactly how it plans to hurt somebody — free of charge. The crews that end up in the report are rarely the ones who got no warning. They're the ones who turned the warning into a story instead of a change.
leadershipThought: Protect the group. Protect the work. Our jobs, our clients, and our reputation depend on it. If you show up and communicate — you protect the group. If you don't — you expose it.
exxonMoments:
Stop Work Authority Exercised — Unsafe Man Basket Operations (Line of Fire)
Man basket work is one of the highest-risk lift operations on an oil and gas site — Stop Work Authority before elevation is always the right call when anything about the setup looks wrong.

Exclusion Zone Breach — Third-Party Personnel (Near Miss) (Line of Fire)
When SimOps create unplanned traffic near your exclusion zone, proactive interception by all crew members — not just the safety tech — is what prevents a line-of-fire exposure.
